paragraphs.source_en: Dumbledore stared for a moment at the sunlit grounds outside the window, then looked back at Harry and said, `Five years ago you arrived at Hogwarts, Harry, safe and whole, as I had planned and intended. Well - not quite whole. You had suffered. I knew you would when I left you on your aunt and uncle's doorstep. I knew I was condemning you to ten dark and difficult years.'
